style: The site is a role brief: a printed document in Newsreader on cool paper, marked up in blue pencil that draws underlines, rings, ticks, arrows and handwritten margin notes as you read.

concept.idea: Every recruiting engagement starts from a written role brief, so the site is one: a numbered document the recruiter has already marked up for you.
concept.signature: The company name is the document title; on load a blue-pencil double underline draws beneath it and a handwritten 'start here' note writes itself in with an arrow. Each section then gets its own pencil mark (bracket, wavy line, ticks, rings and arrows) as it is read.

jury.note: Round 2 self-score after fixes, from the /jury rubric and fresh shoot/audit evidence (0 serious axe, 0 audit FAIL, no overflow). Round 1 was a blind critic; its scores are in blindRound1.
